run_sam_mask_generation: run automatic mask generation on images from a dataset using SAM with configurable model type and checkpoint
write_masks_to_folder: write SAM-generated masks as PNG images and metadata CSV to a specified output folder
get_amg_kwargs: get AMG configuration kwargs from argparse arguments, filtering out None values
convert_masks_to_full_segmentation: convert SAM mask results into full segmentation maps by merging masks and assigning unified class labels
extract_key_objects_from_masks: extract key object masks from SAM results by filtering on size, area ratio, and overlap criteria
